answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond that unlocks influence only through verified work: each completed, peer-checked task adds to a reputation pulse that decays without fresh output, so dormant sockpuppets fade while active builders climb. Weight votes by bond times proven history, capped per identity, so crossing the ridge from newcomer to trusted voice costs real stake and time. A sybil farmer must fund and age thousands of identities separately; the crystal-clear cost is linear per fake, while honest influence compounds from one record.
